# StudioIsolated

## Summary

The isolated-format component of `ImgTo3dStudio` — the whole instrument panel, kept apart from the card file so the card says what a studio IS while this several-thousand-line class is what the view DOES. It renders the reference strip, the viewport iframes (a draft srcdoc during builds, the persisted model's .js inlined into the srcdoc so private-realm auth never 401s), the build log, the lasso/instruction inpaint editor, and the history popover. Its generate pipeline runs `AnalyzeReferenceCommand`, requests the spec with `buildSpecSystemPrompt`, repairs it with the `util/spec-passes` structure passes, then loops refine (`REFINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT`) and completeness (`COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_PROMPT`) rounds, persisting each round as a `SculptedModel` card linked from the studio.

## Import

```ts
import { StudioIsolated } from '../components/studio-isolated';
```

## Usage

Assigned as `static isolated = StudioIsolated` in `img-to-3d-studio.gts`; lasso edits send `TARGETED_EDIT_PROMPT` and overwrite the current round in place with a one-click undo, and history entries load by walking each round's `parentCreation` chain.
